body.heading: Where in the world is El Salvador?
paragraphs: El Salvador is a country in Central America, which is part of North America.

body.heading: The capital city
paragraphs: The capital of El Salvador is San Salvador.

body.heading: Words you might hear
paragraphs: The language you will hear most in El Salvador is Spanish.

body.heading: Money in your pocket
paragraphs: The money of El Salvador is the US dollar. Yes — the very same dollars used in the United States! El Salvador swapped its old colón for US dollars in 2001, and dollars are the money of everyday life.

body.heading: How big is El Salvador?
paragraphs: El Salvador covers about 21,000 square kilometres of land and inland water. That makes it about half the size of Dominican Republic.

body.heading: Two places we'd love to visit
paragraphs: The Flower Route winds through mountain coffee towns like Juayúa and Apaneca — weekend food festivals, waterfalls and colourful murals along the way.
El Salvador's Pacific 'Surf City' coast centres on El Tunco, a laid-back beach town named for its pig-shaped rock, with waves for every level.
